claim_verbatim: meteorological consensus (NOAA CPC, IRI, ECMWF) confirms ENSO-neutral conditions will persist through June 2026, transitioning to an El Niño event by May–July 2026 with a 75% probability.
context: Craig republished the meteorological consensus probability for El Niño onset.
source: Essay: War, El Niño, Pestilence, and Famine
resolution_criterion: YES if NOAA CPC declares El Niño present by end of July 2026; NO otherwise.
resolution_rule_fixed: YES if NOAA CPC declares El Niño present by end of July 2026; NO otherwise.
resolution_source_planned: NOAA CPC ENSO Diagnostic Discussion / ONI
mechanism: Upstream sulphuric acid/naphtha shock colliding with forecasted severe El Niño for 2026–2027.
consensus_source: NOAA CPC / IRI / ECMWF ensemble consensus as cited in the essay
notes: Stated probability is the consensus figure he published. Edge=0. NOAA El Niño Advisory 2026-10-08: Niño-3.4 ~+2.1°C.

claim_verbatim: NOAA forecasts indicate a 50% risk that El Niño conditions in 2026 will reach an intensity sufficient to force canal authorities to implement severe capacity and draft restrictions.
source: Essay: War, El Niño, Pestilence, and Famine
resolution_criterion: YES if Panama Canal Authority imposes severe capacity or draft restrictions in calendar 2026 comparable to 2023–24 drought regime; NO otherwise.
resolution_rule_fixed: YES if Panama Canal Authority imposes severe capacity or draft restrictions in calendar 2026 comparable to 2023–24 drought regime; NO otherwise.
mechanism: El Niño reducing Panamanian watershed rainfall enough to force severe restrictions.
consensus_source: NOAA forecast risk as cited in the essay
notes: Year still open. Early Oct 2026 ACP raising draft/slots after prior water stress. Stated 50% is NOAA figure republished.

claim_verbatim: Where will it trade Silver will trade above $90 an ounce within twelve months. Physical demand will drive it.
resolution_criterion: YES if LBMA/COMEX spot or front-month silver prints >= USD 90/oz between 2026-09-08 and 2027-09-08 inclusive; NO otherwise.
resolution_rule_fixed: YES if LBMA/COMEX spot or front-month silver prints >= USD 90/oz between 2026-09-08 and 2027-09-08 inclusive; NO otherwise.
resolution_source_planned: COMEX/LBMA silver spot or futures settlement
mechanism: Physical demand will drive it. Structural deficit of at least 46 million ounces annually.
notes: Spot ~USD 60 on 2026-10-08. Prior 2026 highs above $90 before date_made do not count. Inferred will→0.90.

claim_verbatim: By 2028, demand (>30 Mt) outstrips likely supply (~28-29 Mt) by roughly 1 to 2 million tonnes.
source: Essay: COPPER: LIMITS TO GROWTH IN THE AGE OF DEMAND SIMULTANEITY
resolution_criterion: YES if ICSG (or equivalent) reports calendar-2028 refined copper demand exceeds refined supply by at least 1.0 Mt; NO if surplus or deficit under 1.0 Mt.
resolution_rule_fixed: YES if ICSG (or equivalent) reports calendar-2028 refined copper demand exceeds refined supply by at least 1.0 Mt; NO if surplus or deficit under 1.0 Mt.
mechanism: Simultaneity of electrification, AI infrastructure, and rearmament vs constrained mine/refined supply.
notes: Inferred 0.70 from likely. Criterion uses lower bound >=1 Mt.

claim_verbatim: Even under the most optimistic “perfect execution” scenarios, assuming no strikes, no political expropriations, and seamless project ramp-ups, the industry can physically scale to only ~25 Mt by 2028.
source: Essay: COPPER: LIMITS TO GROWTH IN THE AGE OF DEMAND SIMULTANEITY
probability_words: can physically scale to only ~25 Mt
resolution_criterion: YES if global primary copper mine production in 2028 is at or below 25.5 Mt; NO if it exceeds 25.5 Mt.
resolution_rule_fixed: YES if global primary copper mine production in 2028 is at or below 25.5 Mt; NO if it exceeds 25.5 Mt.
notes: Ceiling framed as physical limit; mapped to will/certain band 0.90. ±0.5 Mt rounding tolerance.

claim_verbatim: This implies a global refined copper market exceeding 30 Mt by 2028.
source: Essay: COPPER: LIMITS TO GROWTH IN THE AGE OF DEMAND SIMULTANEITY
resolution_criterion: YES if global refined copper usage/demand for 2028 exceeds 30.0 Mt on ICSG (or equivalent); NO otherwise.
resolution_rule_fixed: YES if global refined copper usage/demand for 2028 exceeds 30.0 Mt on ICSG (or equivalent); NO otherwise.
